Agent response: That's a wonderful question, especially when you're just starting out! For a first-timer, focusing on safety and practicality is key. At Namesake, we prioritize both, so you can feel confident in your choices. 😊 When it comes to safety, here's what makes our products a great choice: Rigorous Safety Standards: All our products are designed to be safe for your baby and family. We work closely with our factories to ensure every item meets or exceeds the highest quality standards, including ASTM International and U.S. CPSC safety standards. For example, our crib slats can withstand 135+ lbs, far exceeding the required 80 lbs. Non-Toxic Materials and Finishes: We use a non-toxic multi-step staining and painting process. Our paints are formaldehyde and lead-safe, with undetectable levels of formaldehyde and less than 2 ppm of toxic materials (far exceeding the requirement of less than 300 ppm). We also perform voluntary annual paint tests. Sustainable Wood: Our cribs, dressers, and changers are primarily made from New Zealand Pine Wood, a sustainable and renewable resource. This means they've been independently tested and verified to meet rigorous safety standards for chemical emissions and volatile organic compounds (VOCs), contributing to cleaner indoor air. You can learn more about our commitment to safety on our Safety page. For an 'easiest choice' as a first-timer, I'd recommend looking at our convertible cribs: Many of our cribs are designed to grow with your child, converting from a crib to a toddler bed and sometimes even a daybed or full-size bed.
